name: ranked-list
title: Ranked List
description: A numbered list of labels and counts with column headers, for top-N breakdowns. Rows spread to fill the card and scroll past that. Uses namespace exports: RankedList.Root.

docs.lead: Labels ranked by count, each behind a numbered badge. Pass the rows already in order; the list numbers them as given.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Four rows spread evenly down the card.

examples.title: Many rows
examples.description: Rows past what the card fits scroll inside it. A long label truncates and keeps its full text in a tooltip.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows in rank order. Not sorted for you

props.name: columnLabels
props.description: Headers over the label column and the value column
